subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When an operator invokes implement-now for one issue on the repository's configured GitHub, Forgejo, or Carina tracker, the invoking agent shall read that issue and prepare a bounded goal, scope, acceptance criteria, and independent implementation/review requirements; the executor shall accept that intake without requiring a draft, PRD, technical design, or plan for the issue.
rationale: a small existing issue should enter the reusable worker directly
fit_criterion: each supported tracker admits a bounded issue with none of the planning artifacts present; unresolved product decisions or work requiring decomposition are reported before implementation spend; plan invocation remains available
